purpose: Prevent strong candidates from aging in verificationQueue while preserving fail-closed evidence and BA/remote eligibility.

promotionReady.action: attempt safe promotion path; if write is blocked, keep top of queue and record blocker

score85To89.action: verify hard requirements, location and current listing status

below85.action: recheck only if source/listing remains active or scarcity justifies it

hardLocationRule: Only ba-area or evidence-grade remote-ok may become LIVE. Distant onsite/regular hybrid is rejected; unclear remote remains quarantine.

expiry.actionAfterExpiry: downgrade confidence or close pending state; never silently promote

expectedBenefit: Cuts time between discovery and application by forcing the best pending BA/remote opportunities to be resolved first instead of remaining indefinitely in verification.
